resolution.question: Three families on the same cul-de-sac are trying to set up a school-run carpool. Will they agree a weekly driving rota before term starts on Monday morning?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff (2026-09-07T08:00:00+12:00), the persistent event history shows that all three families have explicitly agreed to a specific weekly driving rota (e.g., via a shared message or verbal agreement recorded in the simulation). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
